chunks.rationale: recordSuggestion / resolveSuggestion / work_suggest are the write path for user-facing chips. Dedupe, cap, and terminal-only resolve must match src/shared/ipc.ts or the renderer will show stale or reopenable chips.
risks: Open-title dedupe is case-insensitive on title only; two different prompts with the same label collapse
resolveSuggestion does not reject already-terminal chips (started can be dismissed later — intentional unless the UI hides them)
work_suggest refreshDetail is best-effort; if runner.refreshDetail is missing the chip waits for the next stream tick

chunks.rationale: forkThread worktree:true (same Ask/canHostWorktree guards as forkWorkerThread), createIssue (gh create then best-effort plan:todo), IPC/preload channels, suggestedWorkNoteFor in the dispatch note chain.
risks: createIssue parses the last /NNN from gh stdout; extra URLs in stderr should not leak because we read stdout
No --label on create: a repo without plan:todo still files the issue, but the board column may stay unlabeled until setPlanStatus retries
suggestedWorkNoteFor is process-global via activeServers(); tests that register coder-threads can race across files

chunks.rationale: services.test.js covers truncation/cap/dedupe/resolve/fork guards/note gating. issues.test.js uses the existing CODER_GH_BIN seam. ipc-seam pins the new channels. orch-server tools/list includes work_suggest.
risks: suggestedWorkNoteFor gating mutates the process-wide MCP registry
createIssue success test assumes setPlanStatus always issues the remove-label form
Renderer wireClient/devCoder stubs are the sibling worker's job; typecheck will fail until they land
Chip UI does not exist yet; backend writes are invisible until the renderer half merges
